name: facebook-messenger-ai-rep
description: Single-Agent Facebook Messenger AI Customer Service Representative

scripts.build: bun run --filter='!@messenger/dashboard' build && bun run --filter='@messenger/dashboard' build
scripts.test: bun run --filter='!@messenger/dashboard' build && bunx vitest run --exclude tests/postgres-acceptance.test.ts
scripts.typecheck: bun run --filter='!@messenger/dashboard' build && bun run --workspaces typecheck
scripts.test:postgres-acceptance: bun run --filter='!@messenger/dashboard' build && vitest run tests/postgres-acceptance.test.ts
scripts.test:dashboard-acceptance: bun run --filter=@messenger/dashboard build && bun run scripts/dashboard-browser-acceptance.ts
